s: A company wants to retire its Oracle Solaris NFS storage arrays. The company requires rapid data migration over its internet network connection to a combination of destinations for Amazon S3, Amazon EFS, and Amazon FSx for Windows File Server. The company also requires a full initial copy, as well as incremental transfers of changes until the retirement of the storage arrays. All data must be encrypted and checked for integrity. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?
o: Configure AWS Application Migration Service. Create a project and deploy the AWS Replication Agent and token to the storage array. Run the migration plan to start the transfer.
Configure AWS DataSync. Configure the DataSync agent and deploy it to the local network. Create a transfer task and start the transfer.
Configure the aws S3 sync command. Configure the AWS client on the client side with credentials. Run the sync command to start the transfer.
Configure AWS Transfer for FTP. Configure the FTP client with credentials. Script the client to connect and sync to start the transfer.
e: AWS DataSync is the optimal solution for this migration requirement because it: l Supports rapid data migration over internet connections l Can transfer data to multiple destinations simultaneously: Amazon S3, Amazon EFS, and Amazon FSx for Windows File Server l Provides automatic data encryption in transit and at rest l Includes built-in data integrity verification (checksums) l Supports both full initial copies and incremental transfers for ongoing synchronization l Handles high volumes of data efficiently This is purpose-built for large-scale data migration scenarios requiring multi-destination support and ongoing incremental transfers, making it superior to alternatives like AWS Snowball (one-time transfer only) or manual solutions.

w.y: Moving NFS data to S3, EFS and FSx for Windows over the internet with full plus incremental copies, encryption and integrity checks is exactly what AWS DataSync does. The agent runs on premises next to the arrays.

o.A: Application Migration Service replicates servers, not storage arrays or file shares.
o.B: Correct: DataSync agent and tasks to all three destinations with encryption and verification.
o.C: aws s3 sync only targets S3, not EFS or FSx.
o.D: Transfer Family is for FTP/SFTP clients to S3 or EFS, not FSx for Windows, and needs scripting.
